title: Insulin Pump Program Customer Terms: Ending a Program
content:
**Who can end it.** Only the customer can end an active Insulin Pump Program: Larkfield records the cancellation as a program cancellation request, and the program closes only when the customer personally confirms that request.

**Closure reason.** A confirmed cancellation closes the program as discontinued by the customer, or as a change of supplier when the customer states they are moving these supplies to another supplier. A cancellation of a program on hold is closed under the program's administrative closure rules.

**What ending a program does not change.** Ending a program carries no fee and cancels nothing the customer already owes: the balance stays payable, credit balances are still refunded under the account statement terms, and unopened items delivered within the return window stay returnable under the return terms. A package already shipped is not recalled.

**What lapses.** Authorized units remaining on a closed program lapse and are never shipped; a later restart needs a new referral and a new program.

| Question | Answer under these terms |
|---|---|
| Does closing cost a fee? | No |
| Is a balance still owed after closing? | Yes, it stays payable |
| Can units still authorized on the closed program be shipped? | No, they lapse |
| Can the customer restart the same program later? | A restart needs a new referral and a new program |
